answers.q1: All line* entries (lineabove, linebelowheader, linebetweenrows, linebelow) are None; headerrow is partial(_dokuwiki_row, "^"), datarow is partial(_dokuwiki_row, "|"), and padding=0.
answers.q2: The tabulate docstring format list (plus a doctest), the cli.py help text, the README format list, the README CLI help, and a new README section.
answers.q3: It escapes each cell's `|` as `%%|%%` and `^` as `%%^%%`, wrapping the literal separators in DokuWiki no-format markers.
answers.q4: Decimal is treated like right alignment: "  " + value.rstrip() + " ". None/unknown alignment falls to the default: " " + value.strip() + " ".
answers.q5: Because tabulate has already padded cells to column width before the row callback runs; the agent re-trims that padding so short cells don't look centered in DokuWiki, then adds DokuWiki-appropriate spacing.
answers.q6: It checks that an empty table yields "" and that a header-only table yields just a header row (exact strings not shown in the material).
answers.q7: test_dokuwiki_header_alignment (headersglobalalign="center") failed; it expected `^  name   ^` but got `^   name   ^`, and the agent edited the expected string to match the actual output.
answers.q8: The agent searched online for DokuWiki table syntax and read DokuWiki's syntax.txt and handler.php. Which fetch failed is not shown in the material, so unknown.
answers.q9: ruff check with the default config failed with exit 1 and 190 errors (e.g. RUF022, RUF100 on unchanged lines); the agent then retried with --config pyproject.toml, which also exited 1.
answers.q10: It patched test/test_output.py to collapse the tabulate(...) call in test_dokuwiki_escape_separators onto one line, then reran ruff check with a hand-picked --select set (E4,E7,E9,F,W,B,C4,ISC,I,C90,UP with ignores) and ruff format --check, both of which passed.

q1.why: All key facts: None lines, partial rows with ^ and |, padding=0.

q2.why: Mentions docstring, cli.py, README, but doesn't clearly name files like tabulate/__init__.py; essentially covers all three though. Slightly vague on files, no note about tabulate_formats.

q3.why: Gives correct escaping but doesn't state it applies to both header and data cells.

q4.why: Decimal like right with two leading spaces, and None/unknown stripped with single spaces.

q5.why: Cells pre-padded, stripping avoids looking centered.

q6.why: Gives no exact assertions; the answer is vague and doesn't state the header-only string.

q7.why: Names test and fix to expected string, but omits README/docstring example updates and that code wasn't changed.

q8.why: Says handler.php was read and the failed fetch unknown; wrong, handler.php returned 404.

q9.why: Misses the snap read-only failure and /snap/ruff/1713/bin/ruff switch; describes a different sequence.
